title: esenbeckia berlandieri subsp. acapulcensis
intro: Esenbeckia berlandieri subsp. acapulcensis, commonly known as Mexican bitterroot, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Mexican bitterroot include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mexican bitterroot include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
